name: Syndicate Boyfriend: Gem Heist
source:
Socialite by day and cat burglar by night, you're the infamous marvel burglarizing Shine City's elites. Ever since your ex-partner betrayed you, you've sworn off working with others, but once you receive an enticing invitation from a group of alluring thieves, curiosity strikes. Can the four of you successfully infiltrate the world's most expensive casino to steal the pink diamond, or are these sly guys simply stray dogs?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.jewelheist]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
白天你是社交名媛，入夜化作飛賊。閃耀市的權貴們屢遭光顧，那個惡名遠揚的神偷就是你。自從被前搭檔背叛，你就發誓再也不跟別人合作。可當一群迷人的盜賊送來誘人的邀請，你還是起了好奇心。你們四人能成功潛入全世界最昂貴的賭場，偷走那顆粉鑽嗎？還是說，這幾個狡猾的傢伙其實只是一群野狗？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.jewelheist]Google Play[/url]］
